violations.text: Sanitizer bucket observed in one of the hand-washing sinks. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 - 400 ppm. Water observed to be too hot. Sanitizer bay of the 3-bay sink was drained and refilled using proper water temperature. Sanitizer concentration observed at 300 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application has been provided and is to be submitted. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2025

The door to the outside, located in receiving, is not tight-fitting. Space observed at the bottom of the door. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

Refrigerator door gasket of lowboy #4 (near drive thru) observed in poor repair, splitting away from the door. Gasket has been received and is to be installed. Lowboy #3 is in poor repair and is not currently being used. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2025
No person in charge was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 06/13/2025

Lowboy #3 was observed held at 46 degrees Fahrenheit. Coffee milk was observed at 45 degrees F. Ice observed at the back of the unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS products had been placed in this unit less than 2 hours prior to inspection and was moved to properly functioning unit. Walk-in cooler observed with a temperature of 44 degrees F. Food products in this unit observed at 44 degrees F. Service call was placed and is expected within the hour. Large bags of ice placed around TCS foods in this unit and walk-in freezer door was opened to cool down the walk-in cooler rapidly. Product observed at 40 degrees F at the end of inspection. Product temperatures must be carefully monitored and more ice added as needed until unit is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2025
